utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Oren. When is the collection?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that, Leo? I still have my doubts about this repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What's the issue, Kira?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Jules, I'm really nervous about organizing this repair drive. What if someone gets hurt fixing the playground?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Don't worry, Pia, we've got safety covered! I'm sure everyone will be careful, especially with the kids' playground.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: But Jules, do we have insurance or waivers sorted? I don't want anyone suing the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara! I'm glad we can chat about the repair drive. I was thinking we could go door-to-door to spread the word—what do you think?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's a great idea, Rosa! I can help with that—maybe we can start on our block tomorrow afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara! Let's meet at my place around 2 PM tomorrow and map out the route.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are you going to the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think so! I need to find that old laptop first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, bring it along. They'll take old electronics.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, I was just talking to Jules about the repair drive. How's it going on your end?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Ira! I'm not sure of the exact time yet, but I said I'd ask around. I also heard Jules might invite the gardening club to share tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's great that the gardening club might get involved—tools are always in demand at these drives.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Every bit helps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: And don't you worry, hon—Mrs. Gable's church group is behind it, and they do great work!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's good to know. I hope it all comes together soon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Eli, do you know when the repair drive at the community center is?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm not certain yet, but Vik said he'd ask around and let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Okay, I'll wait to hear from you or Vik then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Rosa thinks we should go door-to-door instead of just flyers.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That's a smart idea, Bo. I could hand out flyers while I'm walking around with my tool box.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that could work. Just keep it quick, you know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I'll bring my old toaster then. Thanks for confirming.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No problem, Hana! I might be a few minutes late to the event, but I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, no problem. I'll save you a spot if you want.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Opal, do you know if we have enough brushes? I'm worried we're running low.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm not sure about the brushes, Cleo. Maybe check with Rosa; she's been handling the tools inventory.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'll ask Rosa then. Thanks, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Noah, I just confirmed with Mara that I'll be handling the morning drop-off from 9 to noon for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Morning drop-off? That sounds good... wait, what time did you say? I might have missed that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'll be there from 9 to noon to receive donations for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Sam, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? It's at the community center on Maple Street, starting at 10 AM Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great! I'd love to help out—do you need me to bring any tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Just bring yourself and a willingness to lend a hand! They'll have tools and supplies there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Tess, are you free to help me sort through the supply list for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely! I've been looking forward to it. Did you hear about the tools Gus is bringing? Should be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great news about Gus! I'm more worried about paint and brushes though—do you know if we have enough?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Opal, I heard from Uli that the repair drive's been slow. How are things looking from your end?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Well, it's this Saturday at the community center—I checked the schedule myself. Maybe Uli didn't get the update?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Wait, this Saturday? I thought it wasn't until next month. Glad you checked!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nell, what about you? Got anything to fix?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hmm, I'm not sure. I haven't heard much about what kinds of things they take. What do you have?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I'm bringing my old toaster. They fix small appliances, so you should bring whatever you've got.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven't heard about the repair drive. What's that about?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It's a community event this Saturday where folks bring broken items and we fix 'em together. I'm bringing my tools to help out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds like a great idea. What kind of items are people bringing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's at the community center this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM. Hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll try to stop by, but no promises.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, hope to see you there! It'll be a fun way to help out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Eli, are you free to help with the drop-off this weekend? We're collecting donations from 9 to noon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Faye. I've got plenty of time Saturday, so I can help from 9 to noon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Eli! I'll see you Saturday morning then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Sam, I remember now – the repair drive is for fixing the community center roof, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, that's the one. Let me know if you need a hand with it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam! I was thinking of sorting through some old electronics I have. Any chance you could point me to where we're dropping things off?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I'll bring my toaster then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, Hana—the repair drive's for the playground equipment, not toasters. I'm not sure that's the right fit.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, I thought it was for small appliances. So it's just playground stuff? I'll leave my toaster at home.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Bo, sorry I'm late. How's the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It's fine, we're just doing flyers. Should be good enough.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Alright, glad it's coming together. Sorry again for being late.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I've been all over the place lately. Did we set a time for that?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think it's this Saturday morning. I'm gathering a group — want to join?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday? Sounds good. I think I have some paint in the garage we could use.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Leo, how's the repair drive planning going?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's on track. Just need more electronics donated.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Maybe we can put up flyers or ask neighbors directly—I'm happy to help with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure about this repair drive? I've heard some shady things about those.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I haven't heard anything like that. It's put on by the community center, and I trust them. What have you heard?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Well, I heard some drives just collect donations without actually doing repairs, but I guess if the community center runs it, it might be legit.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
